jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.How You’ll Make an Impact * Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performanceWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwideAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #LI-HL1

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as an EHS Manager (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in supporting and advising the GT Transformer business on essential environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements. Imagine driving initiatives that foster a culture of safe behavior and helping us climb the safety culture ladder. You will lead training initiatives within the EQS team, ensuring continuous improvement under our Zero Harm framework and integrated management systems, particularly focusing on ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. Your analytical skills will shine as you track incident statistics and support root cause analyses, all while promoting regulatory compliance and closing any gaps.How You’ll Make an Impact * Drive initiatives to enhance a culture of safety within the organization* Lead and support necessary EHS training initiatives to promote awareness and compliance* Analyze EHS data and report incident statistics to identify trends and areas for improvement* Provide guidance on environmental, health, and safety issues, ensuring regulatory compliance* Facilitate regular meetings within the EQS community to promote information exchange and updates* Support root cause analysis of EHS events and track identified actions for continuous improvementWhat You Bring* A Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as engineering, industrial engineering, or environmental engineering* Several years of EHS experience in manufacturing or a related industry, ideally within Grid Technologies* Strong communication skills, akin to those of an influencer or salesperson, to effectively promote safety culture* Training as a specialist in occupational safety is a significant advantage* Experience in high-risk activities such as cranes & lifting, machine guarding, and energy isolation* Proficiency in EHS management systems (ISO 14001; ISO 45001) and skills in auditing and root cause investigation* Good written and spoken German and English skills, with a willingness to travel occasionallyAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid.
